map.妊娠与非妊娠切点不同？: Do the cut-offs differ in and out of pregnancy?
map.是。非妊娠按 WHO：2h≥11.1 为糖尿病、7.8–11.0 为 IGT；妊: Yes. Outside pregnancy the WHO criteria apply: 2h ≥11.1 indicates diabetes and 7.8-11.0 indicates IGT. In pregnancy IADPSG is stricter (any one of fasting ≥5.1, 1h ≥10.0, 2h ≥8.5 means GDM).
map.试验前怎么准备？: How should I prepare before the test?
map.试验前 3 天每日碳水≥150 g，试验前夜空腹 8–14 小时，试验中禁食、静: At least 150g carbohydrate daily for 3 days before, 8-14 hours of fasting the night before, then no food, sitting quietly, no smoking or vigorous activity during the test, and draw the blood on time.
